_comment: Vendored pad table of the stock KiCad 8.0.9 footprint, extracted once from the official kicad-footprints repository (Rev 13.0, J2 VTX power pads) so tools/verify_mcu_core_sch.py S11 can check the land pattern offline. Units mm, footprint frame (y down), 'at' = [x, y, rotation_deg]; numbered pads only (paste-only sub-pads omitted).
descr: Soldered wire connection, for 2 times 0.25 mm² wires, basic insulation, conductor diameter 0.65mm, outer diameter 1.7mm, size source Multi-Contact FLEXI-E_0.25 (https://ec.staubli.com/AcroFiles/Catalogues/TM_Cab-Main-11014119_(en)_hi.pdf), bend radius 3 times outer diameter, generated with kicad-footprint-generator
